name: v0.23.3
body:
## Highlights

Co-op Translator 0.23.3 fixes false Markdown translation failures when a target language naturally moves prose around an inline-code placeholder within the same Markdown-boundary scope, especially in table cells.

The validator now accepts valid translated word order while continuing to reject missing prose, placeholder loss or duplication, token movement across Markdown boundaries, and structural-placeholder mismatches.

## Verification

- Live Azure provider smoke test completed with the production-shaped Italian table case.
- Full non-live test suite: 585 passed.
- GitHub CI passed on Python 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, and 3.14.
- Ruff, Black, Poetry lock validation, and diff checks passed.
- Wheel and source distribution built successfully.
- The wheel reported version 0.23.3, installed successfully with standard pip in an isolated environment, and the installed CLI smoke test passed.

## What's Changed

* Build(deps): Bump pillow from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/573
* Build(deps): Bump dnspython from 2.8.0 to 2.9.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/576
* Build(deps): Bump certifi from 2026.7.22 to 2026.10.18 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/577
* Build(deps): Bump mcp from 1.29.1 to 1.30.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/578
* Core: Accept natural prose reordering around inline code by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/581
* Build: Bump version to 0.23.3 by @skytin1004 in https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/pull/582

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Azure/co-op-translator/compare/v0.23.2...v0.23.3
